groups.words: Could this headline be a touch warmer?

slips.name: Moss
slips.text: Warmer it is: I set it in the hand-lettered face and softened the ochre.

asks.name: Moss
asks.title: The cover: which sketch goes to print?
asks.body:
Both read well small. Which goes to print?

Choose:
- The wave: calmer on the shelf.
- The sun: brighter, louder.
